parsed.note: Doubling TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE is a legitimate training hyperparameter change that does not touch the fixed evaluation or the held-out EVAL_SHARD=0, so val_bpb still measures real model quality (though the post's claim of a 'best' 1.105 vs. 1.089 looks like a reporting error since lower bpb is better).
